bug_info.bug_desc: In the old code, the slow-domain configuration register slow_main_pd_no is initialized to 1'b0 in its reset block. Per the reset-state requirements, the main power keep-alive control must be asserted after reset so that the main power domain is not requested to power down. Resetting slow_main_pd_no to 1'b0 therefore drives the output to the wrong inactive/unsafe state after rst_slow_ni is released, until a subsequent configuration synchronization updates it.
bug_info.fix_hint: Initialize slow_main_pd_no to 1'b1 in the slow-domain reset block so that after reset the main power keep-alive control is asserted and matches the safe inactive power-management state. Keep the existing configuration synchronization update path that transfers main_pd_ni on slow_cdc_sync.
